<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<!-- SECURITY META -->
<meta http-equiv="X-Content-Type-Options" content="nosniff">
<meta http-equiv="Referrer-Policy" content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin">
<meta http-equiv="Permissions-Policy" content="camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()">
<meta name="referrer" content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin">
<title>Agenda da Barbearia</title>
<style>
:root{
  font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --bg:#050709;
  --bg2:#0a0d11;
  --card:#0f1318;
  --card2:#141920;
  --border:#1e2530;
  --border2:#28303d;
  --ink:#edeae4;
  --muted:#8c8579;
  --faint:#4a4740;
  --gold:#d4a843;
  --gold-light:#f0cc6e;
  --gold-dim:rgba(212,168,67,.12);
  --gold-glow:rgba(212,168,67,.22);
  --green:#1a5c3a;
  --green-text:#4ade96;
  --red:#7d2418;
  --red-text:#f87171;
  --shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  --shadow-lg:0 8px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  --radius:16px;
  --radius-sm:10px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);min-height:100vh;line-height:1.5}
button,input,select{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
::selection{background:var(--gold);color:#000}

/* ── CADASTRO STEPS ── */
#step-identify,#step-register,#step-book{transition:opacity .18s}
.step-returning{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(26,92,58,.25),rgba(212,168,67,.08));border:1.5px solid var(--green);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.step-new-badge{background:var(--gold-dim);border:1.5px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);border-radius:8px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
#identifyBtn:disabled,#registerBtn:disabled,#bookBtn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}

/* ── SCROLLBAR ── */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px;height:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--bg)}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border2);border-radius:99px}

/* ── TOPO FIXO ── */
.top{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;
  background:rgba(14,16,20,.88);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.topin{
  max-width:1200px;margin:auto;
  padding:12px 24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.mark{
  width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold) 0,#a07020 100%);
  color:#000;display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-weight:900;font-size:17px;flex-shrink:0;
}
.brand-name{font-weight:800;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink)}
.brand-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
.city-pill{
  border:1px solid var(--border2);border-radius:999px;
  padding:6px 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
  background:var(--card);white-space:nowrap;
}

/* ── LAYOUT ── */
.wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;padding:28px 24px 64px}

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 300px;gap:16px;
  margin-bottom:20px;align-items:start;
}
.hero-main{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#111620 0%,#0f1a14 55%,#1a140a 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;
  padding:32px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-main::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:-60px;right:-60px;
  width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,168,67,.12) 0,transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
/* ── LOGO ── */
.hero-logo-wrap{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.hero-logo-wrap{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;
  margin-bottom:12px;
}
.hero-logo-img{
  width:90px;height:90px;
  border-radius:50%;
  object-fit:cover;
  border:2px solid rgba(212,168,67,.6);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(212,168,67,.15), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.hero-brand-text{
  font-size:24px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  line-height:1.2;
}
/* ── EYEBROW / TÍTULOS ── */
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  background:var(--gold-dim);border:1px solid rgba(212,168,67,.25);
  color:var(--gold-light);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;
  border-radius:999px;padding:5px 12px;margin-bottom:8px;width:fit-content;
}
.hero-main h1{
  font-size:32px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:900;
  color:#fff;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.hero-main h1 span{color:var(--gold-light)}
.hero-desc{color:#a09890;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;max-width:580px}
/* .hero-stats moved to strip */
.stat{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  border-radius:12px;padding:14px;
}
.stat strong{display:block;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;margin-bottom:3px}
.stat span{font-size:11px;color:#7a7068;font-weight:500}

/* ── INFO PANEL ── */
.info-panel{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:20px;padding:20px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.info-block{}
.info-label{
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px;
}
.info-val{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5}

/* ── HORÁRIO SEMANAL ── */
.weekly-hours{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin-top:2px}
.wh-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px}
.wh-day-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.wh-day{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.wh-day.today{color:#edeae4;font-weight:700}
.wh-day.closed{color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}
.hoje-badge{
  font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;
  background:#4ade96;color:#000;
  padding:2px 7px;border-radius:99px;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.wh-times{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
.wh-time-am{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#6aaddb}
.wh-time-pm{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#3fbcb0}
.wh-closed-txt{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;text-align:right}
.tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
.tag{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  color:var(--ink);padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
}
.social-link{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  color:var(--gold-light);padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:700;transition:border-color .15s;
}
.social-link:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.map-btn{
  margin-top:8px;width:100%;height:36px;
  background:var(--gold-dim);border:1px solid rgba(212,168,67,.3);
  color:var(--gold-light);border-radius:9px;
  font-size:13px;font-weight:700;transition:all .15s;
}
.map-btn:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#000;border-color:var(--gold)}
.divider{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:0 -4px}

/* ── TABS ── */
.tabs{
  display:flex;gap:4px;
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:14px;padding:6px;
  margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.tab{
  flex:1;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:9px;
  background:transparent;color:var(--muted);
  font-weight:700;font-size:14px;transition:all .18s;
}
.tab:hover{background:var(--card2);color:var(--ink)}
.tab.active{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold) 0,#a87a20 100%);
  color:#000;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(212,168,67,.3);
}

/* ── GRID PRINCIPAL ── */
.main-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 300px;gap:16px}

/* ── PAINEL ── */
.panel{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.panel-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px}
.panel-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.5}

/* ── FORMULÁRIO ── */
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.field{}
.label{
  display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;
  color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:7px;
}
.input{
  width:100%;height:48px;
  background:var(--bg2);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:11px;padding:0 14px;color:var(--ink);
  outline:none;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;
  -webkit-appearance:none;
}
.input:focus{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--gold-dim)}
.input::placeholder{color:var(--faint)}
select.input{
  cursor:pointer;
  -webkit-appearance:auto;appearance:auto;
  background-image:none;
}
input[type="date"].input{
  -webkit-appearance:auto;appearance:auto;
  color-scheme:dark;
}

/* ── LGPD GATE (tela cheia, bloqueante) ── */
#lgpd-gate{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:500;
  background:rgba(5,7,9,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
}
#lgpd-gate.hidden{display:none}
.lgpd-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:24px;max-width:520px;width:100%;
  padding:36px 32px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
.lgpd-card .lgpd-icon{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:12px}
.lgpd-card h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:8px}
.lgpd-card p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:6px}
.lgpd-card a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer}
.lgpd-card .lgpd-list{
  margin:14px 0;padding:14px;
  background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:12px;list-style:none;
}
.lgpd-card .lgpd-list li{
  font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;
  padding-left:14px;position:relative;
}
.lgpd-card .lgpd-list li::before{
  content:'•';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--gold);
}
.lgpd-card .lgpd-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:22px}
.lgpd-card .btn-accept{
  flex:1;height:48px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold) 0,#a07020 100%);
  color:#000;border:none;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;
  cursor:pointer;transition:filter .15s;
}
.lgpd-card .btn-accept:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
.lgpd-card .btn-reject{
  height:48px;padding:0 20px;background:transparent;
  color:var(--muted);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;
  cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.lgpd-card .btn-reject:hover{border-color:var(--border);color:var(--ink)}

/* ── LGPD CONSENT CHECKBOX ── */
.consent-row{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;
  margin-top:14px;padding:12px 14px;
  background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:10px;
}
.consent-row input[type=checkbox]{
  width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px;
  accent-color:var(--gold);cursor:pointer;
}
.consent-row label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer}
.consent-row label a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline}

/* ── MODAL PRIVACIDADE ── */
#privacy-modal{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
}
#privacy-modal.open{display:flex}
.privacy-box{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:20px;max-width:600px;width:100%;
  max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:32px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
.privacy-box h2{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:16px;color:var(--ink)}
.privacy-box h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);margin:16px 0 6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.privacy-box p,.privacy-box li{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.privacy-box ul{padding-left:18px;margin-top:6px}
.privacy-box .close-btn{
  margin-top:24px;width:100%;background:var(--gold);color:#000;
  border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;font-weight:700;
  font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;
}

/* ── SLOTS ── */
.slots-section{margin-top:20px}
.slots-label{
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:10px;
}
.slots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
.slot{
  height:46px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:10px;
  background:var(--bg2);color:var(--muted);
  font-weight:700;font-size:13px;transition:all .15s;
}
.slot:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold-light);background:var(--gold-dim)}
.slot.active{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold) 0,#a07020 100%);
  color:#000;border-color:var(--gold);
  box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(212,168,67,.35);
}

/* ── BOTÕES ── */
.btn{
  height:50px;border:0;border-radius:12px;
  font-weight:800;font-size:14px;padding:0 22px;
  transition:all .15s;cursor:pointer;
}
.btn-primary{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold) 0,#a07020 100%);
  color:#000;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(212,168,67,.3);
}
.btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);box-shadow:0 4px 28px rgba(212,168,67,.45)}
.btn-secondary{
  background:var(--card2);color:var(--ink);
  border:1.5px solid var(--border2);
}
.btn-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--border);background:var(--bg2)}
.btn-full{width:100%;margin-top:18px}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;filter:none}
.btn-loading{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.btn-loading::before{
  content:'';display:inline-block;width:16px;height:16px;
  border:2px solid rgba(0,0,0,.3);border-top-color:#000;
  border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite;flex-shrink:0;
}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.4}50%{opacity:.9}}
.slots-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px}
.slots-count{
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  background:var(--gold-dim);border:1px solid rgba(212,168,67,.25);
  color:var(--gold-light);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;
}

/* ── AVISOS ── */
.notice{
  margin-top:14px;padding:13px 16px;border-radius:11px;
  font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;
}
.notice-info{background:rgba(212,168,67,.08);border:1px solid rgba(212,168,67,.2);color:var(--gold-light)}
.notice-ok{background:rgba(26,92,58,.25);border:1px solid rgba(74,222,150,.2);color:var(--green-text)}
.notice-bad{background:rgba(125,36,24,.25);border:1px solid rgba(248,113,113,.2);color:var(--red-text)}

/* ── RESUMO ── */
.summary{
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:22px;
  position:sticky;top:76px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;
}
.summary-title{
  font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:16px;
}
.sum-row{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.sum-row:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.sum-key{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.sum-val{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);text-align:right;max-width:160px}
.sum-highlight{color:var(--gold-light)}
.summary-note{
  margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  font-size:12px;color:var(--faint);line-height:1.5;
}

/* ── CARDS PLANOS ── */
.plan-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:20px}
.plan-card{
  background:var(--bg2);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:14px;padding:16px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;
}
.plan-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold-light);background:var(--card2)}
.plan-card.featured{
  border-color:rgba(212,168,67,.4);background:rgba(212,168,67,.06);
}
.plan-cards.has-selection .plan-card.featured:not(.selected){
  border-color:var(--border2);background:var(--bg2);
}
.plan-card.selected{
  border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(212,168,67,.1);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--gold-dim);
}
.plan-badge{
  display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;
  background:var(--gold);color:#000;border-radius:999px;
  padding:3px 9px;margin-bottom:8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;
}
.plan-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
.plan-price{font-size:24px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold-light)}
.plan-period{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}
.plan-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5}

/* ── AGENDAMENTOS ── */
.appt{
  background:var(--bg2);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:12px;padding:14px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;
  cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s;
}
.appt:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.appt-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.appt-detail{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ── HIDDEN ── */
.hidden{display:none!important}

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:960px){
  .hero,.main-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .summary{position:static}
  .hero-main h1{font-size:26px}
  .hero-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .slots{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .plan-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .city-pill{display:none}
  .info-panel{display:none}
  /* Hero logo em telas médias */
  .hero-logo-img{height:44px;max-width:140px}
  .hero-brand-text{font-size:17px}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .wrap{padding:14px 12px 48px}
  .hero-main{padding:20px;border-radius:16px;gap:14px}
  .hero-main h1{font-size:21px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .hero-desc{font-size:13px}
  .hero-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
  .hero-stats .stat:last-child{display:none}
  .hero-logo-img{height:38px;max-width:120px}
  .hero-brand-text{font-size:15px}
  .tabs{gap:3px;padding:4px}
  .tab{height:40px;font-size:13px}
  .form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .slots{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .panel{padding:16px;border-radius:14px}
  .topin{padding:10px 14px}
  .mark{width:32px;height:32px;font-size:14px;border-radius:8px}
  .brand-name{font-size:13px}
  .brand-sub{font-size:11px}
  .info-panel{padding:16px}
}

/* ── STATS STRIP ── */
.hero-stats-strip{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.hero-stats-strip .stat{

      <li><strong>Número de WhatsApp</strong> — para envio de confirmação e lembretes</li>
      <li><strong>Data e horário escolhidos</strong> — para reserva na agenda</li>
      <li><strong>Serviço e barbeiro</strong> — para organização interna</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>Como usamos</h3>
    <ul>
      <li>Confirmar o agendamento via WhatsApp</li>
      <li>Enviar lembrete 24h e 5h antes do horário</li>
      <li>Permitir remarcação ou cancelamento</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>Com quem compartilhamos</h3>
    <p>Seus dados não são vendidos nem compartilhados com terceiros. São acessados apenas pelo gestor da barbearia para fins operacionais.</p>
    <h3>Por quanto tempo guardamos</h3>
    <p>Os dados ficam na agenda enquanto o agendamento estiver ativo. Após o atendimento, permanecem no histórico por até 12 meses para fins de gestão interna.</p>
    <h3>Seus direitos (LGPD — Art. 18)</h3>
    <ul>
      <li>Solicitar acesso, correção ou exclusão dos seus dados</li>
      <li>Revogar o consentimento a qualquer momento</li>
      <li>Entrar em contato pelo WhatsApp da barbearia</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>Base legal</h3>
    <p>Tratamento baseado no consentimento do titular (Art. 7º, I da LGPD) e na execução de contrato de prestação de serviços (Art. 7º, V).</p>
    <button class="close-btn" onclick="closePrivacy()">Entendi ✓</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
// Lê ?client= da URL para suporte multi-tenant
const CLIENT_ID = (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('client') || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g,'') || 'default';
// API base absoluta — funciona tanto no n8n quanto em host estático (Vercel, etc.)
const API_BASE = 'https://<REDACTED_PRIVATE_HOST>/webhook';
const api = p => API_BASE + '/' + p;
const apiC = p => api(p) + (p.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'client=' + CLIENT_ID;

const DEF_SERVICES = {'Corte masculino':45,'Barba':35,'Corte + barba':75,'Acabamento':25,'Sobrancelha':20,'Pezinho':20};
const DEF_PLANS = {'Essencial':160,'Barba em dia':120,'Premium':280};
let prices = { services:{...DEF_SERVICES}, plans:{...DEF_PLANS} };
let selectedPlan = null;
let config = {};
let selectedSlot = '';
let selectedEvent = '';
let selectedRSlot = '';

const services = ['Corte masculino','Barba','Corte + barba','Acabamento','Sobrancelha','Pezinho'];

function today() {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function money(v) {
  return 'R$ ' + Number(v || 0).toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 0 });
}

function fmtDate(iso) {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split('-');
  return d + '/' + m + '/' + y;
}

function notice(id, text, type) {
  const cls = { ok: 'notice-ok', bad: 'notice-bad', info: 'notice-info' }[type] || 'notice-info';
  $(id).innerHTML = '<div class="notice ' + cls + '">' + text + '</div>';
  if (type === 'ok') setTimeout(() => { if ($(id)) $(id).innerHTML = ''; }, 6000);
}

async function getJson(url, opt) {
  const r = await fetch(url, opt);
  return r.json();
}

function renderWeeklyHours(cfg) {
  const el = $('weeklyHours');
  if (!el) return;
  const DAYS = ['Domingo','Segunda-Feira','Terça-Feira','Quarta-Feira','Quinta-Feira','Sexta-Feira','Sábado'];
  const closed = cfg.closedWeekdays || [0];
  const start  = cfg.startHour  || '08:00';
  const end    = cfg.endHour    || '20:00';
  const today  = (function(){var fmt=new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US",{timeZone:"America/Sao_Paulo",weekday:"short"});var s=fmt.format(new Date());return ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"].indexOf(s);})(); // BRT timezone-locked
  const startH = parseInt(start.split(':')[0], 10);

  const rows = DAYS.map((name, i) => {
    const isToday  = i === today;
    const isClosed = closed.includes(i);
    const badge    = isToday ? '<span class="hoje-badge">Hoje</span>' : '';
    const dayCls   = isClosed ? 'wh-day closed' : (isToday ? 'wh-day today' : 'wh-day');

    if (isClosed) {
      return `<div class="wh-row">
        <div class="wh-day-wrap"><span class="${dayCls}">${name}</span>${badge}</div>
        <span class="wh-closed-txt">Fechado</span>
      </div>`;
    }

    let timesHtml;
    if (startH < 12) {
      timesHtml = `<span class="wh-time-am">${start} – 12:00</span>
                   <span class="wh-time-pm">12:00 – ${end}</span>`;
    } else {
      timesHtml = `<span class="wh-time-pm">${start} – ${end}</span>`;
    }

    return `<div class="wh-row">
      <div class="wh-day-wrap"><span class="${dayCls}">${name}</span>${badge}</div>
      <div class="wh-times">${timesHtml}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  el.innerHTML = rows;
}

function fillSelect(id, items) {
  $(id).innerHTML = items.map(x => '<option>' + x + '</option>').join('');
}

function getActiveTab() {
  const t = document.querySelector('.tab.active');
  return t ? t.dataset.tab : 'book';
}

function updateSummary() {
  const tab = getActiveTab();
  const note = $('sumNote');

  if (tab === 'plans') {
    const plan = selectedPlan || $('pPlan').value || Object.keys(prices.plans || {})[0] || '—';
    const p = prices.plans && prices.plans[plan];
    $('sumService').textContent = plan || '—';
    $('sumPrice').textContent = p ? money(p) + '/mês' : '—';
    $('sumDate').textContent = 'Mensal';
    $('sumTime').textContent = '—';
    $('sumBarber').textContent = '—';
    if (note) note.textContent = 'A barbearia entrará em contato pelo WhatsApp para confirmar os horários do plano.';
  } else if (tab === 'reschedule') {
    const svc = $('rService').value || services[0];
    const p = prices.services && prices.services[svc];
    $('sumService').textContent = svc;
    $('sumPrice').textContent = p ? money(p) : '—';
    $('sumDate').textContent = $('rDate').value ? fmtDate($('rDate').value) : '—';
    $('sumTime').textContent = selectedRSlot
      ? new Date(selectedRSlot).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
      : '—';
    $('sumBarber').textContent = $('rBarber').value || '—';
    if (note) note.textContent = 'Selecione seu agendamento, o novo horário e confirme a remarcação.';
  } else {
    const svc = $('service').value || services[0];
    const p = prices.services && prices.services[svc];
    $('sumService').textContent = svc;
    $('sumPrice').textContent = p ? money(p) : '—';
    $('sumDate').textContent = $('date').value ? fmtDate($('date').value) : '—';
    $('sumTime').textContent = selectedSlot
      ? new Date(selectedSlot).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
      : '—';
    $('sumBarber').textContent = $('barber').value || '—';
    if (note) note.textContent = 'Horários ocupados são bloqueados automaticamente após cada reserva.';
  }
}

async function loadBase() {
  // Preenche selects e datas IMEDIATAMENTE com defaults (antes de qualquer API)
  ['service', 'rService'].forEach(id => fillSelect(id, services));
  ['barber', 'rBarber'].forEach(id => fillSelect(id, ['Primeiro disponível']));
  $('date').value = today(); $('date').min = today();
  $('rDate').value = today(); $('rDate').min = today();
  renderPlans();
  updateSummary();

  // Busca preços e config em paralelo (com clientId para multi-tenant)
  const [resP, resC] = await Promise.allSettled([
    getJson(apiC('agenda-projeto-1-precos')),
    getJson(apiC('agenda-projeto-1-config'))
  ]);

  if (resP.status === 'fulfilled') {
    const p = resP.value;
    prices.services = { ...DEF_SERVICES, ...(p.services || {}) };
    prices.plans    = { ...DEF_PLANS,    ...(p.plans    || {}) };
    prices.planDescriptions = p.planDescriptions || {};
  }

  if (resC.status === 'fulfilled') {
    // ── TRIAL GATE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const rv = resC.value;
    if (rv.trialActive === false) {
      const bizName = (rv.config && rv.config.name) || 'Barbearia';
      const wa = (rv.config && rv.config.whatsapp) ? rv.config.whatsapp.replace(/\D/g,'') : '';
      const msg = encodeURIComponent('Olá! Gostaria de reativar minha agenda online. Pode me informar sobre os planos disponíveis?');
      document.getElementById('trial-biz-name').textContent = 'A agenda de ' + bizName + ' está temporariamente desativada. O período de avaliação gratuita foi encerrado.';
      document.getElementById('trial-wa-btn').href = wa ? 'https://wa.me/55' + wa + '?text=' + msg : 'https://wa.me/?text=' + msg;
      document.getElementById('trial-gate').style.display = 'block';
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      return; // Para aqui — não carrega slots, não mostra agenda
    }
    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    config = resC.value.config || {};
    const barbers = (config.barbers && config.barbers.length) ? config.barbers : ['Primeiro disponível'];
    ['barber', 'rBarber'].forEach(id => fillSelect(id, barbers));

    const bizName = config.name || 'Barbearia';
    $('brandName').textContent = bizName;
    $('brandCity').textContent = config.city || 'Sorocaba/SP';
    $('topCity').textContent = '\u{1F4CD} ' + (config.city || 'Sorocaba/SP');
    $('infoAddress').textContent = config.address || 'Não informado';
    $('heroHours').textContent = (config.startHour || '08') + '–' + (config.endHour || '20') + 'h';
    renderWeeklyHours(config);

    // Logo / brand name no hero
    const logoWrap = $('heroLogoWrap');
    if (config.logoUrl) {
      $('heroLogoImg').src = config.logoUrl;
      $('heroLogoImg').alt = bizName;
      $('heroLogoImg').style.display = 'block';
      $('heroBrandText').textContent = '';
      $('heroBrandText').style.display = 'none';
      logoWrap.style.display = 'flex';
    } else if (bizName && bizName !== 'Barbearia') {
      $('heroLogoImg').style.display = 'none';
      $('heroBrandText').textContent = bizName;
      $('heroBrandText').style.display = 'block';
      logoWrap.style.display = 'flex';
    }
    // Update topbar mark letter
    const markEl = document.querySelector('.mark');
    if (markEl) markEl.textContent = bizName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

    if (config.whatsapp) {
      $('infoWhatsappLink').href = 'https://wa.me/55' + String(config.whatsapp).replace(/\D/g, '');
    }
    if (config.instagram) {
      $('infoInstagram').href = config.instagram.startsWith('http')
        ? config.instagram
        : 'https://instagram.com/' + config.instagram.replace('@', '');
    }
    if (config.address) {
      $('openMaps').onclick = () => window.open(
        'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=' + encodeURIComponent(config.address), '_blank'
      );
    }
  }

  renderPlans();
  updateSummary();
  // Slots carregam apenas quando o cliente avança para o passo 3
}

async function loadSlots(target = 'slots', dateId = 'date', serviceId = 'service', autoAdvance = false) {
  const box = $(target);
  const countEl = $(target + 'Count') || $(target === 'slots' ? 'slotsCount' : 'rSlotsCount');
  // Skeleton loader — 8 botões pulsando
  box.innerHTML = '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px">' +
    Array(8).fill('<div style="height:46px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--card2);border:1.5px solid var(--border);animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite"></div>').join('') +
    '</div>';
  if (countEl) countEl.style.display = 'none';
  selectedSlot = '';
  if (target === 'rSlots') selectedRSlot = '';
  try {
    const j = await getJson(
      apiC('agenda-projeto-1-disponibilidade') + '&date=' + $(dateId).value + '&service=' + encodeURIComponent($(serviceId).value)
    );
    if (j.blocked || !j.slots || !j.slots.length) {
      // Auto-avança para o próximo dia disponível (até 7 dias à frente)
      if (autoAdvance) {
        const cur = new Date($(dateId).value + 'T00:00:00');
        cur.setDate(cur.getDate() + 1);
        const next = cur.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        $(dateId).value = next;
        return loadSlots(target, dateId, serviceId, false);
      }
      const msg = j.blocked
        ? 'Agenda fechada neste dia. Escolha outra data.'
        : 'Sem horários livres nessa data. Tente outro dia.';
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-bad">' + msg + '</div>';
      return;
    }
    if (countEl) {
      countEl.textContent = j.slots.length + ' horário' + (j.slots.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' livre' + (j.slots.length > 1 ? 's' : '');
      countEl.style.display = '';
    }
    box.innerHTML = j.slots.map(s =>
      '<button class="slot" data-iso="' + s.iso + '">' + s.label + '</button>'
    ).join('');
    box.querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      box.querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
      b.classList.add('active');
      if (target === 'rSlots') selectedRSlot = b.dataset.iso;
      else selectedSlot = b.dataset.iso;
      updateSummary();
    });
  } catch(e) {
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-bad">Não foi possível carregar os horários.</div>';
  }
}

function renderPlans() {
  const planNames = Object.keys(prices.plans || {});
  const featured = planNames.length > 1 ? planNames[planNames.length - 1] : null;
  // Preserva seleção anterior; se não há nenhuma, usa o featured
  if (!selectedPlan || !planNames.includes(selectedPlan)) selectedPlan = featured;
  $('pPlan').innerHTML = planNames.map(p => '<option>' + p + '</option>').join('');
  // ✨ Descrições vêm do servidor (editáveis pelo admin), fallback hardcoded
  const DEF_DESCS = {
    'Essencial': 'Cortes mensais com agendamento prioritário e desconto exclusivo para assinantes.',
    'Barba em dia': 'Manutenção de barba toda semana, sem precisar ligar ou esperar na fila.',
    'Premium': 'Corte + barba ilimitados, atendimento VIP e horários exclusivos reservados para você.'
  };
  const planDescs = Object.assign({}, DEF_DESCS, (prices && prices.planDescriptions) || {});
  $('planCards').innerHTML = planNames.map(p =>
    '<div class="plan-card' + (p === featured ? ' featured' : '') + '" data-plan="' + p + '">' +
    (p === featured ? '<div class="plan-badge">★ Popular</div>' : '') +
    '<div class="plan-name">' + p + '</div>' +
    '<div class="plan-price">' + money(prices.plans[p]) +
    '<span class="plan-period">/mês</span></div>' +
    '<div class="plan-desc">' + (planDescs[p] || 'Atendimento recorrente com condições especiais para assinantes.') + '</div>' +
    '</div>'
  ).join('');
  $('planCards').querySelectorAll('.plan-card').forEach(card => {
    card.onclick = () => {
      selectedPlan = card.dataset.plan;
      $('planCards').classList.add('has-selection');
      $('planCards').querySelectorAll('.plan-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      card.classList.add('selected');
      $('pPlan').value = selectedPlan;
      updateSummary();
    };
  });
  // Restaura seleção
  if (selectedPlan) {
    const sc = $('planCards').querySelector('[data-plan="' + selectedPlan + '"]');
    if (sc) {
      sc.classList.add('selected');
      $('planCards').classList.add('has-selection');
      $('pPlan').value = selectedPlan;
    }
  }
}

// Tabs
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
  b.classList.add('active');
  ['book', 'reschedule', 'plans'].forEach(t =>
    $('tab-' + t).classList.toggle('hidden', t !== b.dataset.tab)
  );
  updateSummary();
});

['service', 'date', 'barber'].forEach(id => $(id).addEventListener('change', () => {
  if (id !== 'barber') loadSlots();
  updateSummary();
}));
$('rBarber').addEventListener('change', updateSummary);
['rService', 'rDate'].forEach(id => $(id).addEventListener('change', () => {
  loadSlots('rSlots', 'rDate', 'rService');
  updateSummary();
}));

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// FLUXO DE CADASTRO EM 3 PASSOS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function showStep(step) {
  ['step-identify', 'step-register', 'step-book'].forEach(id => {
    const el = $(id);
    if (el) el.style.display = id === step ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

function stepNotice(elId, txt, type) {
  const el = $(elId);
  if (!el) return;
  const color = type === 'ok' ? 'var(--green-text)' : type === 'bad' ? 'var(--red-text)' : 'var(--muted)';
  el.innerHTML = txt ? '<span style="color:' + color + '">' + txt + '</span>' : '';
}

// PASSO 1 — Identificação por telefone
async function handleIdentify() {
  const rawPhone = $('phone').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (rawPhone.length < 10) { stepNotice('identifyMsg', 'Informe o WhatsApp com DDD (ex: 11 99999-9999).', 'bad'); return; }
  const btn = $('identifyBtn');
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Verificando...';
  stepNotice('identifyMsg', '', '');
  try {
    const j = await getJson(apiC('agenda-projeto-1-cliente-identificar'), {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ phone: rawPhone, client: CLIENT_ID })
    });
    if (j.ok && j.found) {
      // Cliente cadastrado — pular cadastro, ir direto para agendamento
      $('name').value = j.name || '';
      showClienteBanner(j.name, rawPhone, j.totalVisits, j.lastVisit, true);
      showStep('step-book');
      await loadSlots('slots', 'date', 'service', true);
      updateSummary();
    } else {
      // Cliente novo — mostrar formulário de cadastro
      $('phoneDisplay').textContent = rawPhone.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{4,5})(\d{4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
      $('fieldPhone2').style.display = '';
      $('name').value = '';
      showStep('step-register');
      setTimeout(() => $('name').focus(), 80);
    }
  } catch(e) {
    stepNotice('identifyMsg', 'Não conseguimos verificar. Tente novamente.', 'bad');
  }
  btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Continuar →';
}

$('identifyBtn')?.addEventListener('click', handleIdentify);
$('phone')?.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleIdentify(); });

// PASSO 2 — Cadastro (novos clientes)
$('registerBtn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const nome = $('name').value.trim();
  if (!nome || nome.length < 2) { stepNotice('registerMsg', 'Informe seu nome completo.', 'bad'); return; }
  const rawPhone = $('phone').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
  showClienteBanner(nome, rawPhone, 0, null, false);
  showStep('step-book');
  await loadSlots('slots', 'date', 'service', true);
  updateSummary();
});

$('name')?.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') $('registerBtn')?.click(); });

// Voltar ao passo 1
$('backToPhone')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
  showStep('step-identify');
  stepNotice('registerMsg', '', '');
  $('phone').focus();
});
$('trocarClienteBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
  showStep('step-identify');
  $('phone').value = '';
  $('name').value = '';
  $('slots').innerHTML = '';
  $('slotsCount').style.display = 'none';
  selectedSlot = '';
  $('bookMsg').innerHTML = '';
  $('bookBtn').style.display = '';
  stepNotice('identifyMsg', '', '');
  $('phone').focus();
});

// Banner do cliente identificado
function showClienteBanner(nome, phone, visitas, lastVisit, returning) {
  const initial = (nome || '?').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  $('clienteAvatar').textContent = initial;
  $('clienteNomeBanner').textContent = nome;
  const rawNum = String(phone).replace(/\D/g,'');
  const fmtPhone = rawNum.replace(/(\d{2})(\d{4,5})(\d{4})/, '($1) $2-$3');
  if (returning) {
    const visitStr = visitas === 1 ? '1 visita' : (visitas || 0) + ' visitas';
    const lastStr = lastVisit ? ' · Última: ' + lastVisit : '';
    $('clienteSubBanner').innerHTML = fmtPhone + ' · ' + visitStr + lastStr +
      '  <span style="background:var(--green);color:var(--green-text);border-radius:6px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700">✓ Cadastrado</span>';
  } else {
    $('clienteSubBanner').innerHTML = fmtPhone +
      '  <span style="background:var(--gold-dim);color:var(--gold);border-radius:6px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700">Novo cliente</span>';
  }
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

$('bookBtn').onclick = async () => {
  const errs = [];
  if (!$('name').value.trim()) errs.push('Informe seu nome.');
  const tel = $('phone').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (tel.length < 10) errs.push('Informe um WhatsApp válido (com DDD).');
  if (!selectedSlot) errs.push('Escolha um horário disponível.');
  if (errs.length) { notice('bookMsg', errs.join(' '), 'bad'); return; }
  let lgpdConsent = false;
  try { lgpdConsent = localStorage.getItem('lgpd') === '1'; } catch(e) {}
  const btn = $('bookBtn');
  btnLoading(btn, 'Confirmando...');
  try {
    const j = await getJson(api('agenda-projeto-1-reservar'), {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name: $('name').value.trim(), phone: tel,
        service: $('service').value, barber: $('barber').value,
        start: selectedSlot, lgpdConsent: lgpdConsent,
        clientId: CLIENT_ID,
        _hp: document.getElementById('_hp')?.value || ''
      })
    });
    if (j.ok) {
      // ── Tela de sucesso rica ──
      const svcName = $('service').value;
      const barberName = $('barber').value;
      const clientName = $('name').value.trim();
      let whenStr = '';
      if (selectedSlot) {
        try { whenStr = new Date(selectedSlot).toLocaleString('pt-BR', { timeZone:'America/Sao_Paulo', weekday:'long', day:'2-digit', month:'long', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit' }); } catch(e) {}
      }
      $('bookMsg').innerHTML =
        '<div style="text-align:center;padding:28px 0 8px">' +
          '<div style="font-size:52px;margin-bottom:10px">✅</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px">Agendado com sucesso!</div>' +
          '<div style="background:var(--card2);border:1.5px solid rgba(74,222,150,.2);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin:16px 0;text-align:left;font-size:14px;line-height:2;color:var(--muted)">' +
            '<div>👤 <strong style="color:var(--ink)">' + clientName + '</strong></div>' +
            '<div>✂️ ' + svcName + (barberName && barberName !== 'Primeiro disponível' ? ' · ' + barberName : '') + '</div>' +
            (whenStr ? '<div>🗓 ' + whenStr + '</div>' : '') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px">📲 Confirmação e lembretes serão enviados no WhatsApp.</div>' +
          '<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-full" onclick="resetBooking()">+ Novo agendamento</button>' +
        '</div>';
      $('bookBtn').style.display = 'none';
      $('slots').innerHTML = ''; $('slotsCount').style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      notice('bookMsg', j.message || j.Message || 'Não conseguimos confirmar. Tente novamente.', 'bad');
    }
  } catch(e) { notice('bookMsg', 'Não foi possível concluir agora.', 'bad'); }
  btnReset(btn);
};

function resetBooking() {
  $('name').value = ''; $('phone').value = ''; selectedSlot = '';
  $('bookMsg').innerHTML = '';
  $('bookBtn').style.display = '';
  $('slots').innerHTML = '';
  $('slotsCount').style.display = 'none';
  showStep('step-identify');
  $('phone').focus();
  updateSummary();
}

// ── CANCELAMENTO DO CLIENTE ──
let cancelTarget = null;

function openCancelModal(ev, phone) {
  cancelTarget = { eventId: ev.id || ev.eventId, phone, needsOtp: false };
  const isoStart = ev.start || '';
  let quando = ev.when || '';
  if (!quando && isoStart) {
    try {
      quando = new Date(isoStart).toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
        timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo', weekday: 'long',
        day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit'
      });
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  $('cancelModalInfo').innerHTML =
    '<strong style="color:#edeae4">' + (ev.service || ev.summary || 'Agendamento') + '</strong><br>' +
    (quando ? '🕑 ' + quando + '<br>' : '') +
    (ev.barber && ev.barber !== 'Primeiro disponível' ? '✄ ' + ev.barber : '');
  $('cancelModalMsg').innerHTML = '';
  $('cancelOtpSection').style.display = 'none';
  $('cancelOtpInput').value = '';
  $('cancelConfirmText').style.display = '';
  $('cancelConfirmBtn').textContent = 'Sim, cancelar';
  $('cancelModal').style.display = 'grid';
}

function closeCancelModal() {
  $('cancelModal').style.display = 'none';
  cancelTarget = null;
}

$('cancelModal').addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === $('cancelModal')) closeCancelModal(); });

$('cancelConfirmBtn').onclick = async () => {
  if (!cancelTarget) return;
  const btn = $('cancelConfirmBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = cancelTarget.needsOtp ? 'Verificando...' : 'Cancelando...';
  try {
    const body = { phone: cancelTarget.phone, eventId: cancelTarget.eventId };
    if (cancelTarget.needsOtp) {
      body.otp = ($('cancelOtpInput').value || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (body.otp.length !== 6) {
        $('cancelModalMsg').innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-bad">Digite o código de 6 dígitos.</div>';
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Verificar e cancelar'; return;
      }
    }
    const j = await getJson(api('agenda-projeto-1-cancelar-cliente'), {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    if (j.ok) {
      closeCancelModal();
      const card = $('apptList').querySelector('[data-id="' + cancelTarget.eventId + '"]');
      if (card) card.remove();
      if (!$('apptList').querySelector('.appt-card')) {
        $('apptList').innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-ok">Agendamento cancelado. Até a próxima!</div>';
      }
      notice('resMsg', 'Agendamento cancelado com sucesso.', 'ok');
    } else if (j.needsCode) {
      // Mostrar OTP no modal e enviar código
      cancelTarget.needsOtp = true;
      $('cancelOtpSection').style.display = 'block';
      $('cancelConfirmText').style.display = 'none';
      $('cancelConfirmBtn').textContent = 'Verificar e cancelar';
      $('cancelModalMsg').innerHTML = '';
      // Enviar OTP automaticamente
      const r = await sendOtp(cancelTarget.phone);
      $('cancelModalMsg').innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-' + (r.ok ? 'ok' : 'bad') + '">' +
        (r.ok ? '✅ Código enviado ao WhatsApp!' : (r.message || 'Erro ao enviar código.')) + '</div>';
      setTimeout(() => $('cancelOtpInput').focus(), 80);
    } else {
      $('cancelModalMsg').innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-bad">' + (j.message || 'Não foi possível cancelar.') + '</div>';
    }
  } catch(e) {
    $('cancelModalMsg').innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-bad">Erro de conexão. Tente novamente.</div>';
  }
  btn.disabled = false;
  if (!cancelTarget?.needsOtp || btn.textContent === 'Verificar e cancelar') {
    if (btn.textContent === 'Cancelando...' || btn.textContent === 'Verificando...') btn.textContent = 'Sim, cancelar';
  }
};

// ── OTP helpers ──
let otpPhone = '';

async function sendOtp(phone) {
  try {
    const j = await getJson(api('agenda-projeto-1-solicitar-codigo'), {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ phone })
    });
    return j;
  } catch(e) { return { ok: false, message: 'Erro de conexão.' }; }
}

function showOtpSection(phone) {
  otpPhone = phone;
  $('otpPhone').textContent = phone.replace(/^(\d{2})(\d{4,5})(\d{4})$/, '($1) $2-$3');
  $('otpSection').style.display = 'block';
  $('otpInput').value = '';
  setTimeout(() => $('otpInput').focus(), 80);
}

function hideOtpSection() {
  $('otpSection').style.display = 'none';
  otpPhone = '';
}

function renderApptList(list, tel) {
  const now = new Date();
  if (!list.length) {
    $('apptList').innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-bad">Nenhum agendamento futuro encontrado para este WhatsApp.</div>';
    return;
  }
  $('apptList').innerHTML = '';
  list.forEach(ev => {
    const isFuture = ev.start ? new Date(ev.start) > now : true;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'appt-card';
    card.dataset.id = ev.id || ev.eventId;
    card.style.cssText = 'background:var(--card2);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;transition:border-color .15s';
    card.innerHTML =
      '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0">' +
        '<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">' +
          (ev.service || ev.summary || 'Agendamento') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px">' +
          (ev.when || ev.startLabel || ev.date || '') +
          (ev.barber && ev.barber !== 'Primeiro disponível' ? ' · ' + ev.barber : '') +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0">' +
        (isFuture
          ? '<button class="btn-select" title="Remarcar" style="height:34px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1.5px solid var(--border2);background:var(--card);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s">✎ Remarcar</button>' +
            '<button class="btn-cancel" title="Cancelar" style="height:34px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1.5px solid rgba(248,113,113,.2);background:rgba(125,36,24,.2);color:#f87171;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s">🗑</button>'
          : '<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em">Concluído</span>') +
      '</div>';
    const btnSel = card.querySelector('.btn-select');
    if (btnSel) btnSel.onclick = () => {
      selectedEvent = ev.id || ev.eventId;
      $('apptList').querySelectorAll('.appt-card').forEach(c => c.style.borderColor = 'var(--border2)');
      card.style.borderColor = 'var(--gold)';
      btnSel.style.borderColor = 'var(--gold)'; btnSel.style.color = 'var(--gold-light)';
    };
    const btnCan = card.querySelector('.btn-cancel');
    if (btnCan) btnCan.onclick = () => openCancelModal(ev, tel);
    $('apptList').appendChild(card);
  });
}

$('findBtn').onclick = async () => {
  const tel = $('rPhone').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (tel.length < 10) { $('apptList').innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-bad">Informe um WhatsApp válido para buscar.</div>'; return; }
  hideOtpSection();
  $('apptList').innerHTML = '';
  const btn = $('findBtn');
  btnLoading(btn, 'Buscando...');
  try {
    const j = await getJson(apiC('agenda-projeto-1-meus-agendamentos') + '&phone=' + tel);
    if (j.needsCode) {
      // Enviar OTP automaticamente
      const r = await sendOtp(tel);
      notice('otpMsg', r.ok ? '✅ Código enviado para o WhatsApp!' : (r.message || 'Erro ao enviar código.'), r.ok ? 'ok' : 'bad');
      showOtpSection(tel);
    } else {
      renderApptList(j.events || j.items || j.agendamentos || [], tel);
    }
  } catch(e) { $('apptList').innerHTML = '<div class="notice notice-bad">Não foi possível buscar.</div>'; }
  btnReset(btn);
};

$('verifyOtpBtn').onclick = async () => {
  const code = ($('otpInput').value || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (code.length !== 6) { notice('otpMsg', 'Digite o código de 6 dígitos.', 'bad'); return; }
  const tel = otpPhone || $('rPhone').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
  const btn = $('verifyOtpBtn');
  btnLoading(btn, 'Verificando...');
  try {
    const j = await getJson(apiC('agenda-projeto-1-meus-agendamentos') + '&phone=' + tel + '&otp=' + code);
    if (j.needsCode) {
      notice('otpMsg', j.message || 'Código inválido. Tente novamente.', 'bad');
    } else {
      hideOtpSection();
      renderApptList(j.events || j.items || j.agendamentos || [], tel);
    }
  } catch(e) { notice('otpMsg', 'Erro de conexão. Tente novamente.', 'bad'); }
  btnReset(btn);
};

$('resendOtpBtn').onclick = async () => {
  const tel = otpPhone || $('rPhone').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (!tel || tel.length < 10) return;
  const btn = $('resendOtpBtn');
  btnLoading(btn, '...');
  const r = await sendOtp(tel);
  notice('otpMsg', r.ok ? '✅ Novo código enviado!' : (r.message || 'Erro ao reenviar.'), r.ok ? 'ok' : 'bad');
  btnReset(btn);
};

$('resBtn').onclick = async () => {
  if (!selectedEvent || !selectedRSlot) { notice('resMsg', 'Selecione o agendamento e o novo horário.', 'bad'); return; }
  const btn = $('resBtn');
  btnLoading(btn, 'Remarcando...');
  try {
    const j = await getJson(api('agenda-projeto-1-reagendar'), {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ eventId: selectedEvent, phone: $('rPhone').value, service: $('rService').value, barber: $('rBarber').value, start: selectedRSlot, clientId: CLIENT_ID, _hp: '' })
    });
    notice('resMsg', j.message || j.Message || 'Remarcação confirmada!', j.ok ? 'ok' : 'bad');
  } catch(e) { notice('resMsg', 'Não foi possível remarcar agora.', 'bad'); }
  btnReset(btn);
};

$('planBtn').onclick = async () => {
  const errs = [];
  if (!$('pName').value.trim()) errs.push('Informe seu nome.');
  const pTel = $('pPhone').value.replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (pTel.length < 10) errs.push('Informe um WhatsApp válido.');
  if (errs.length) { notice('planMsg', errs.join(' '), 'bad'); return; }
  const btn = $('planBtn');
  btnLoading(btn, 'Enviando...');
  try {
    const j = await getJson(api('agenda-projeto-1-plano-mensal'), {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name: $('pName').value.trim(), phone: pTel, plan: $('pPlan').value, preferredSchedule: $('pSchedule').value, clientId: CLIENT_ID })
    });
    notice('planMsg', j.message || j.Message || 'Recebemos seu interesse! Entraremos em contato.', j.ok ? 'ok' : 'bad');
  } catch(e) { notice('planMsg', 'Não foi possível enviar agora.', 'bad'); }
  btnReset(btn);
};

// ── MÁSCARA DE TELEFONE ──
function maskPhone(e) {
  let v = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
  if (v.length >= 11) v = '(' + v.slice(0,2) + ') ' + v.slice(2,7) + '-' + v.slice(7);
  else if (v.length > 6) v = '(' + v.slice(0,2) + ') ' + v.slice(2,6) + '-' + v.slice(6);
  else if (v.length > 2) v = '(' + v.slice(0,2) + ') ' + v.slice(2);
  else if (v.length > 0) v = '(' + v;
  e.target.value = v;
}
['phone','rPhone','pPhone'].forEach(id => {
  const el = $(id);
  if (el) { el.addEventListener('input', maskPhone); el.placeholder = '(11) 99999-9999'; }
});

// ── LOADING STATE NOS BOTÕES ──
function btnLoading(btn, msg) {
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn._orig = btn.innerHTML;
  btn.innerHTML = '<span class="btn-loading">' + msg + '</span>';
}
function btnReset(btn) {
  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerHTML = btn._orig;
}


// ── LGPD GATE ──
function closeGate(){
  var g=document.getElementById('lgpd-gate');
  if(g) g.style.display='none';
}

}

  document.getElementById('lgpd-main-content').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('lgpd-rejected').style.display='none';
}
function openPrivacy(){ document.getElementById('privacy-modal').classList.add('open'); }
function closePrivacy(){ document.getElementById('privacy-modal').classList.remove('open'); }
document.getElementById('privacy-modal').addEventListener('click',function(e){

});

try{

// ── CONTATO URGENTE ──
function openContactModal(){
  document.getElementById('contactModalBg').style.display = 'flex';
  // Pré-preenche se já tem nome/telefone da reserva
  try {
    const savedName = $('rName')?.value || $('bName')?.value || '';
    const savedPhone = $('rPhone')?.value || $('bPhone')?.value || '';
    if (savedName) document.getElementById('cmodName').value = savedName;
    if (savedPhone) document.getElementById('cmodPhone').value = savedPhone;
  } catch(_) {}
}
function closeContactModal(){
  document.getElementById('contactModalBg').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('cmodMsg').style.display = 'none';
}
async function sendContactMessage(){
  const name = document.getElementById('cmodName').value.trim();
  const phone = document.getElementById('cmodPhone').value.replace(/\D/g,'');
  const message = document.getElementById('cmodMessage').value.trim();
  const urgent = document.getElementById('cmodUrgent').checked;
  const btn = document.getElementById('cmodSendBtn');
  const msg = document.getElementById('cmodMsg');

  function showM(text, ok){
    msg.textContent = text;
    msg.className = 'cmod-msg ' + (ok ? 'ok' : 'err');
    msg.style.display = 'block';
  }
  if (!name) return showM('Informe seu nome', false);
  if (phone.length < 10) return showM('WhatsApp inválido (DDD + número)', false);
  if (message.length < 5) return showM('Mensagem muito curta', false);

  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Enviando...';
  try {
    const clientId = (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('client') || 'default');
    const r = await fetch(BASE_URL + '/webhook/agenda-projeto-1-contato-urgente', {
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ name, phone, message, urgent, clientId })
    });
    const d = await r.json();
    if (d.ok) {
      showM('✓ ' + d.message, true);
      setTimeout(closeContactModal, 2500);
      document.getElementById('cmodMessage').value = '';
      document.getElementById('cmodUrgent').checked = false;
    } else {
      showM(d.message || 'Erro ao enviar', false);
    }
  } catch(e) {
    showM('Erro de conexão. Tente novamente.', false);
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Enviar mensagem';
  }
}
// Fecha clicando fora
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
  const bg = document.getElementById('contactModalBg');
  if (bg) bg.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if (e.target === bg) closeContactModal(); });
});
</script>

<style>
:root{
  font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --bg:#0e1014;
  --bg2:#13171c;

}

button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}

.login-title{font-size:24px;font-weight:900;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
