// ── Despesas (v2 SaaS) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────���──────
var CAT_LABEL = {
  aluguel: '🏠 Aluguel',
  produtos: '🧴 Produtos',
  contas: '💡 Contas',
  salarios: '👥 Salários',
  manutencao: '🔧 Manuten��ão',
  marketing: '📣 Marketing',
  impostos: '📋 Impostos',
  outros: '📦 Outros'
};

function dspBrl(v){
  return 'R$ '+Number(v||0).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
}
function dspBrlCompact(v){
  v = Number(v||0);
  if (Math.abs(v) >= 1000) return 'R$ '+(v/1000).toFixed(1).replace('.',',').replace(',0','')+'k';
  return dspBrl(v);
}
function dspPeriodoLabel(p){
  return ({hoje:'Hoje',semana:'Esta semana',mes:'Este mês',ano:'Este ano',all:'Todo período'})[p]||p;
}

async function loadDespesas(){
  var periodo = document.getElementById('dspPeriodo').value;
  var listEl = document.getElementById('dspList');
  var catEl  = document.getElementById('dspCatBox');
  listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:24px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px">Carregando...</div>';
  try {
    var token = getAdminToken();
    var r = await fetch(BASE+'/agenda-projeto-1-despesa-listar', {
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: token, periodo: periodo })
    });
    var d = await r.json();
    if (!d.ok) { listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:24px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px">'+(d.message||'Erro')+'</div>'; return; }

    // ── KPIs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    document.getElementById('dspFat').textContent = dspBrl(d.faturamento);
    document.getElementById('dspTot').textContent = dspBrl(d.totalDespesas);
    document.getElementById('dspLuc').textContent = dspBrl(d.lucro);
    document.getElementById('dspMar').textContent = d.margem + '%';

    var pLabel = dspPeriodoLabel(periodo);
    document.getElementById('dspFatSub').textContent = pLabel;
    document.getElementById('dspTotSub').textContent = (d.despesas.length||0) + ' lançamento' + (d.despesas.length===1?'':'s');
    document.getElementById('dspCatSub').textContent = pLabel;
    document.getElementById('dspListSub').textContent = (d.despesas.length||0) + ' registro' + (d.despesas.length===1?'':'s') + ' · ' + pLabel;

    // Lucro: cor vermelha se negativo
    var lucEl = document.getElementById('dspLuc');
    if (d.lucro < 0) { lucEl.classList.remove('gold'); lucEl.style.color = '#ef4444'; document.getElementById('dspLucSub').textContent = 'prejuízo — ajuste gastos'; }
    else if (d.lucro === 0 && d.faturamento === 0) { lucEl.classList.remove('gold'); lucEl.style.color = 'var(--muted)'; document.getElementById('dspLucSub').textContent = 'sem movimentação'; }
    else { lucEl.classList.add('gold'); lucEl.style.color = ''; document.getElementById('dspLucSub').textContent = 'fat − desp'; }

    var marEl = document.getElementById('dspMar');
    if (d.margem < 0) { marEl.style.color = '#ef4444'; document.getElementById('dspMarSub').textContent = 'prejuízo'; }
    else if (d.margem < 20) { marEl.style.color = '#f59e0b'; document.getElementById('dspMarSub').textContent = 'margem baixa'; }
    else if (d.margem < 40) { marEl.style.color = 'var(--gold)'; document.getElementById('dspMarSub').textContent = 'margem saudável'; }
    else { marEl.style.color = '#22c55e'; document.getElementById('dspMarSub').textContent = 'margem ótima'; }

    // ── Breakdown por categoria ──────────────────────────────────────────
    var entries = Object.entries(d.porCategoria||{}).sort(function(a,b){ return b[1]-a[1]; });
    if (!entries.length) {
      catEl.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:24px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px">Sem despesas no período</div>';
    } else {
      catEl.innerHTML = entries.map(function(e){
        var pct = d.totalDespesas>0 ? Math.round(e[1]/d.totalDespesas*100) : 0;
        return '<div class="cat-row">'
          + '<div class="cat-name">'+(CAT_LABEL[e[0]]||e[0])+'</div>'
          + '<div class="cat-val">'+dspBrl(e[1])+'</div>'
          + '<div class="cat-bar"><div class="cat-bar-fill" style="width:'+pct+'%"></div></div>'
          + '<div class="cat-pct">'+pct+'% do total</div>'
          + '</div>';
      }).join('');
    }

    // ── Lista detalhada ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    var arr = d.despesas || [];
    if (!arr.length) {
      listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:32px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px">'
        +'<div style="font-size:32px;margin-bottom:8px;opacity:.4">💸</div>'
        +'Nenhuma despesa registrada<br><span style="font-size:12px;opacity:.7">Use o formulário acima para começar</span></div>';
    } else {
      var monthsAbbr = ['jan','fev','mar','abr','mai','jun','jul','ago','set','out','nov','dez'];
      listEl.innerHTML = arr.map(function(x){
        var dt = new Date(x.data);
        var day = String(dt.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
        var mon = monthsAbbr[dt.getMonth()];
        return '<div class="exp-item">'
          + '<div class="exp-date"><span class="exp-day">'+day+'</span>'+mon+'</div>'
          + '<div class="exp-body">'
          +   '<div class="exp-desc">'+esc(x.descricao||'')+(x.recorrente?' <span style="font-size:9px;background:var(--gold-dim,rgba(212,168,67,.15));color:var(--gold);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:700;vertical-align:middle">RECORRENTE</span>':'')+'</div>'
          +   '<div class="exp-cat">'+(CAT_LABEL[x.categoria]||x.categoria)+'</div>'
          + '</div>'
          + '<div class="exp-val">'+dspBrl(x.valor)+'</div>'
          + '<button class="exp-del" onclick="deleteDespesa(\''+x.id+'\')" title="Excluir despesa">🗑</button>'
          + '</div>';
      }).join('');
    }
  } catch(e){ listEl.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="padding:24px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--red);font-size:13px">Erro de conexão</div>'; }
}

async function saveDespesa(){
  var valor = parseFloat(document.getElementById('dspNewValor').value);
  var cat   = document.getElementById('dspNewCat').value;
  var desc  = document.getElementById('dspNewDesc').value.trim();
  var data  = document.getElementById('dspNewData').value;
  var btn   = document.getElementById('dspNewBtn');
  var msg   = document.getElementById('dspNewMsg');

  function showMsg(text, ok){
    msg.style.display = 'block';
    msg.textContent = text;
    msg.style.background = ok ? 'rgba(34,197,94,.10)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,.10)';
    msg.style.color = ok ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444';
    msg.style.border = '1px solid ' + (ok ? 'rgba(34,197,94,.3)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,.3)');
  }

  if (!valor || valor <= 0) return showMsg('Informe um valor válido', false);
  if (!desc) return showMsg('Informe uma descrição', false);

  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Salvando...';
  try {
    var token = getAdminToken();
    var r = await fetch(BASE+'/agenda-projeto-1-despesa-criar', {
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: token, valor: valor, categoria: cat, descricao: desc, data: data })
    });
    var d = await r.json();

function applyPlanGating() {
  try {
    var sess = (function(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('barber_admin_session')||'null');}catch(_){return null;}})();
    if (!sess) return;
    var features = sess.features || ['agenda','bot_basico','bot_premium','comandas','despesas','reativacao','multi_barber','backup_telegram','relatorios_completos'];

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab="despesas"]').forEach(function(el){ el.style.display = 'none'; });
      var sec = document.getElementById('tab-despesas');
      if (sec) sec.style.display = 'none';

    var planEl = document.getElementById('planBadge');

      }
    }
    if (planEl) {
      var icon = plan === 'empresarial' ? '👑' : (plan === 'profissional' ? '⭐' : '🌱');
      var trialTxt = onTrial ? ' · TRIAL' : '';
      planEl.innerHTML = icon + ' ' + plan.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + plan.slice(1) + trialTxt;
      planEl.title = onTrial && sess.trialExpires ? ('Trial até ' + new Date(sess.trialExpires).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')) : ('Plano ' + plan);
    }

    // Banner suave durante trial
    if (onTrial && sess.trialExpires) {
      var daysLeft = Math.ceil((sess.trialExpires - Date.now()) / 86400000);
      if (daysLeft <= 7 && daysLeft > 0 && !document.getElementById('trialBanner')) {

Após, seu plano cai para <strong>' + (sess.plan==='iniciante'?'Iniciante':'plano contratado') + '</strong>. <a href="https://wa.me/<REDACTED_PHONE_BR>?text=Quero+continuar+no+Profissional" target="_blank" style="color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline">Manter Profissional</a>';
        document.body.insertBefore(b, document.body.firstChild);
      }
    }
  } catch(e) { console.warn('Plan gating error:', e); }
}

function renderPlaceholders(phs) {

  holder.innerHTML = phs.map(function(p){

  }).join('');
}

function copyPlaceholder(key) {
  // Copia para área de transferência E insere no último textarea focado
  try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(key); } catch(_){}
  // Se houver um textarea ativo, insere
  var active = document.activeElement;
  if (active && active.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') {
    var s = active.selectionStart || 0, e = active.selectionEnd || 0;
    active.value = active.value.slice(0,s) + key + active.value.slice(e);
    active.selectionStart = active.selectionEnd = s + key.length;
    active.focus();
    var evt = new Event('input', { bubbles: true });
    active.dispatchEvent(evt);
  } else {
    toast('Variável copiada: ' + key + '. Cole onde quiser.', true);
  }
}

function renderEvents(events) {
  var listEl = document.getElementById('tplEventsList');
  listEl.innerHTML = events.map(function(ev, idx){
    var disabled = !ev.enabled;
    var variants = (ev.custom && ev.custom.length) ? ev.custom : (ev.defaults.slice(0, TPL_DATA.planInfo.maxVariants));
    var isCustom = !!(ev.custom && ev.custom.length);
    return '<div class="tpl-event-card'+(disabled?' tpl-event-disabled':'')+'" data-event="'+ev.id+'">'+
      '<div class="tpl-event-head" onclick="'+(disabled?'':'toggleEvent(this)')+'">'+
      '<div>'+
      '<div class="tpl-event-title"><span style="font-size:18px">'+ev.icon+'</span> '+esc(ev.label)+
      (disabled?' <span class="tpl-locked-badge">🔒 plano superior</span>':'')+
      (isCustom&&!disabled?' <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:rgba(34,197,94,.1);color:#22c55e;border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.3);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;text-transform:uppercase">CUSTOMIZADO</span>':'')+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="tpl-event-when">'+esc(ev.when)+'</div>'+
      '</div>'+
      (disabled?'':'<div class="tpl-event-meta">'+variants.length+'/'+TPL_DATA.planInfo.maxVariants+' variantes <span class="tpl-arrow" style="display:inline-block;margin-left:6px">▼</span></div>')+
      '</div>'+
      (disabled?'':'<div class="tpl-event-body">'+
        variants.map(function(v, vi){ return renderVariant(ev.id, vi, v); }).join('')+
        (variants.length < TPL_DATA.planInfo.maxVariants?'<button class="tpl-add-variant" onclick="addVariant(\''+ev.id+'\')">+ Adicionar variante</button>':'')+
        '<div class="tpl-event-foot">'+
          '<div class="tpl-event-foot-left">'+
          (isCustom?'<button class="btn btn-dark btn-sm" onclick="resetEvent(\''+ev.id+'\')">↺ Restaurar padrão</button>':'')+
          '</div>'+
          '<button class="btn btn-gold btn-sm" onclick="saveEvent(\''+ev.id+'\')">💾 Salvar mensagens</button>'+
        '</div>'+
        '<div class="tpl-msg" id="tplMsg_'+ev.id+'"></div>'+
      '</div>')+
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function renderVariant(eventId, idx, text) {
  return '<div class="tpl-variant" data-vi="'+idx+'">'+
    '<div class="tpl-variant-head">'+
      '<span>Variante '+(idx+1)+'</span>'+
      '<div class="tpl-variant-actions">'+
        '<button onclick="previewVariant(\''+eventId+'\','+idx+')">👁 Pré-ver</button>'+
        '<button onclick="removeVariant(\''+eventId+'\','+idx+')" title="Remover">✕</button>'+
      '</div>'+
    '</div>'+
    '<textarea data-event="'+eventId+'" data-vi="'+idx+'" oninput="markDirty(\''+eventId+'\')" placeholder="Digite a mensagem... use {cliente}, {servico}, etc.">'+esc(text)+'</textarea>'+
    '</div>';
}

function toggleEvent(headEl) {
  headEl.parentElement.classList.toggle('open');
}

function markDirty(eventId) {
  TPL_DIRTY[eventId] = true;
}

function addVariant(eventId) {
  var card = document.querySelector('.tpl-event-card[data-event="'+eventId+'"] .tpl-event-body');
  var addBtn = card.querySelector('.tpl-add-variant');
  var variants = card.querySelectorAll('.tpl-variant');
  if (variants.length >= TPL_DATA.planInfo.maxVariants) return;
  var newIdx = variants.length;
  var html = renderVariant(eventId, newIdx, '');
  addBtn.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', html);
  if (variants.length + 1 >= TPL_DATA.planInfo.maxVariants) addBtn.style.display='none';
  markDirty(eventId);
}

function removeVariant(eventId, idx) {
  var card = document.querySelector('.tpl-event-card[data-event="'+eventId+'"] .tpl-event-body');
  var variants = card.querySelectorAll('.tpl-variant');
  if (variants.length <= 1) { toast('Pelo menos 1 variante é obrigatória.', false); return; }
  variants[idx].remove();
  // Renumera
  card.querySelectorAll('.tpl-variant').forEach(function(v, i){
    v.dataset.vi = i;
    v.querySelector('.tpl-variant-head span').textContent = 'Variante ' + (i+1);
    v.querySelector('textarea').dataset.vi = i;
    v.querySelector('.tpl-variant-actions button:first-child').setAttribute('onclick', "previewVariant('"+eventId+"',"+i+")");
    v.querySelector('.tpl-variant-actions button:last-child').setAttribute('onclick', "removeVariant('"+eventId+"',"+i+")");
  });
  var addBtn = card.querySelector('.tpl-add-variant');
  if (addBtn) addBtn.style.display='block';
  markDirty(eventId);
}

function previewVariant(eventId, idx) {
  var ta = document.querySelector('.tpl-event-card[data-event="'+eventId+'"] textarea[data-vi="'+idx+'"]');
  if (!ta) return;
  var sample = {
    '{cliente}':'João',
    '{servico}':'Corte masculino',
    '{barbeiro}':'Pedro',
    '{data}':'amanhã (29/05)',
    '{hora}':'14:00',
    '{link}': BASE + '/webhook/agenda-projeto-1'
  };
  var text = ta.value;
  Object.entries(sample).forEach(function(e){ text = text.split(e[0]).join(e[1]); });
  document.getElementById('tplPreviewBody').textContent = text;
  document.getElementById('tplPreviewModal').style.display = 'flex';
}

async function saveEvent(eventId) {
  var card = document.querySelector('.tpl-event-card[data-event="'+eventId+'"]');
  var variants = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('textarea')).map(function(t){ return t.value.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
  var msg = document.getElementById('tplMsg_'+eventId);
  msg.style.display = 'block';
  if (!variants.length) { msg.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,.1)'; msg.style.color='#ef4444'; msg.textContent='Pelo menos 1 variante é obrigatória.'; return; }
  try {
    var token = getAdminToken();
    var r = await fetch(BASE+'/agenda-projeto-1-admin-templates',{
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: token, action:'save', eventId:eventId, variants:variants })
    });
    var d = await r.json();
    if (d.ok) {
      msg.style.background='rgba(34,197,94,.1)'; msg.style.color='#22c55e';
      msg.textContent='✓ '+(d.message||'Salvo!')+' ('+d.count+' variante'+(d.count===1?'':'s')+')';
      delete TPL_DIRTY[eventId];
      setTimeout(function(){ msg.style.display='none'; loadTemplates(); }, 1500);
    } else {
      msg.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,.1)'; msg.style.color='#ef4444';
      msg.textContent = d.message || 'Erro ao salvar';
    }
  } catch(e){ msg.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,.1)'; msg.style.color='#ef4444'; msg.textContent='Erro de conexão'; }
}

async function resetEvent(eventId) {
  if (!confirm('Restaurar as mensagens padrão deste evento? Suas customizações serão perdidas.')) return;
  try {
    var token = getAdminToken();
    var r = await fetch(BASE+'/agenda-projeto-1-admin-templates',{
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: token, action:'reset', eventId:eventId })
    });
    var d = await r.json();
    if (d.ok) { toast(d.message || 'Restaurado!', true); loadTemplates(); }
    else toast(d.message || 'Erro', false);
  } catch(e){ toast('Erro de conexão', false); }
}

async function generatePayment(){
  if (!PAY_SELECTED_PLAN) return;
  var cpf = document.getElementById('payCpf').value.replace(/\D/g,'');
  var email = document.getElementById('payEmail').value.trim();
  var phone = document.getElementById('payPhone').value.replace(/\D/g,'');
  var msg = document.getElementById('payStep2Msg');
  var btn = document.getElementById('payGenBtn');
  msg.style.display = 'none';
  if (cpf.length < 11) { msg.style.display='block'; msg.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,.1)'; msg.style.color='#ef4444'; msg.textContent='CPF inválido (use só números, 11 dígitos)'; return; }
  if (!email || !/.+@.+\..+/.test(email)) { msg.style.display='block'; msg.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,.1)'; msg.style.color='#ef4444'; msg.textContent='E-mail inválido'; return; }

  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Gerando QR Pix...';
  try {
    var token = getAdminToken();
    var r = await fetch(BASE+'/agenda-projeto-1-pagamento-criar', {
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: token, plan: PAY_SELECTED_PLAN.id, cpfCnpj: cpf, email: email, phone: phone })
    });
    var d = await r.json();
    if (!d.ok) { msg.style.display='block'; msg.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,.1)'; msg.style.color='#ef4444'; msg.textContent = d.message || 'Erro ao gerar cobrança'; return; }
    // Mostra QR
    if (d.payment.qrCode) document.getElementById('payQrImg').src = d.payment.qrCode;
    if (d.payment.qrPayload) document.getElementById('payQrPayload').value = d.payment.qrPayload;
    PAY_DATA = d.payment;
    payShowStep(3);
    startPolling(d.payment.id);
  } catch(e){ msg.style.display='block'; msg.style.background='rgba(239,68,68,.1)'; msg.style.color='#ef4444'; msg.textContent='Erro de conexão'; }
  finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Gerar Pix →'; }
}

}

function startPolling(paymentId){
  stopPolling();
  PAY_POLL_COUNT = 0;
  PAY_POLL_TIMER = setInterval(async function(){
    PAY_POLL_COUNT++;
    if (PAY_POLL_COUNT > 60) { // 5min de polling
      stopPolling();
      document.getElementById('payStatus').innerHTML = '⏰ Tempo limite. Se você pagou, atualize a página em alguns minutos.';
      document.getElementById('payStatus').style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,.1)';
      document.getElementById('payStatus').style.color = '#ef4444';
      return;
    }
    try {
      var token = getAdminToken();
      var r = await fetch(BASE+'/agenda-projeto-1-pagamento-listar', {
        method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({ token: token })
      });
      var d = await r.json();
      if (d.ok && d.payments) {
        var p = d.payments.find(function(x){ return x.id === paymentId; });
        if (p && (p.status === 'CONFIRMED' || p.status === 'RECEIVED' || p.status === 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED' || p.status === 'PAYMENT_RECEIVED')) {
          stopPolling();
          payShowStep(4);
        }
      }
    } catch(e){}
  }, 5000);
}
function stopPolling(){
  if (PAY_POLL_TIMER) clearInterval(PAY_POLL_TIMER);
  PAY_POLL_TIMER = null;
}

function updateTrialBanner(){
  var sess = getSession();
  if (!sess) return;
  var banner = document.getElementById('trialBanner');
  if (!banner) return;
  // Default e superadmin não veem banner
  if (sess.subscriptionActive || sess.clientId === 'default' || sess.clientId === 'superadmin' || sess.isSuperAdmin) {
    banner.style.display = 'none'; return;
  }
  var status = sess.trialStatus || 'active';
  var days = typeof sess.trialDaysLeft === 'number' ? sess.trialDaysLeft : null;
  if (status === 'active' && (days === null || days > 7)) {
    banner.style.display = 'none'; return;
  }
  // Mostra banner
  banner.style.display = 'flex';
  banner.className = 'trial-banner';
  var icon = document.getElementById('trialBannerIcon');
  var title = document.getElementById('trialBannerTitle');
  var sub = document.getElementById('trialBannerSub');
  var cta = document.getElementById('trialBannerCta');
  if (status === 'grace') {
    banner.classList.add('grace');
    icon.textContent = '⚠️';
    title.textContent = 'Período de teste vencido';
    sub.textContent = 'Você está em carência. Ative sua assinatura para não perder acesso.';
    cta.textContent = '💳 Ativar agora';
  } else if (status === 'warning' || (days !== null && days <= 7 && days >= 0)) {
    banner.classList.add('warning');
    icon.textContent = '⏰';
    title.textContent = 'Faltam ' + days + ' dia' + (days === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' do seu teste grátis';
    sub.textContent = 'Garanta acesso contínuo ativando sua assinatura.';
    cta.textContent = '💳 Ativar (R$ 119/mês)';
  } else {
    banner.style.display = 'none'; return;
  }
  // Link de pagamento — por enquanto leva pro WhatsApp do vendedor
  var msg = encodeURIComponent('Olá! Quero ativar minha assinatura do AgendaBarber. Cliente: ' + (sess.name || sess.clientId));

}

async function acceptOnboarding(){

  try {
    var r = await fetch(BASE+'/agenda-projeto-1-admin-clientes', {
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: getToken(), action:'recordOnboarding', items: items })

async function loadClientMessages(){
  const body = document.getElementById('inboxBody');
  if (!body) return;
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="inbox-empty">Carregando...</div>';
  try {
    const r = await fetch(BASE + '/agenda-projeto-1-admin-clientes', {
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: getToken(), action:'listClientMessages' })
    });
    const d = await r.json();
    if (!d.ok) { body.innerHTML = '<div class="inbox-empty">Erro</div>'; return; }
    const list = d.messages || [];
    const unread = list.filter(m => m.status === 'unread').length;
    document.getElementById('inboxSub').textContent =
      list.length + ' mensagem' + (list.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + (unread > 0 ? ' · ' + unread + ' não lida(s)' : '');
    if (!list.length) {
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="inbox-empty">Sem mensagens.</div>';
      return;
    }
    body.innerHTML = list.slice(0, 20).map(function(m){
      const cls = 'inbox-row ' + (m.urgent ? 'urgent ' : '') + (m.status === 'unread' ? 'unread' : 'read');
      const icon = m.urgent ? '🚨' : '📩';
      const safeMsg = (m.message||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
      const safeName = (m.name||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
      return '<div class="' + cls + '">' +
        '<div class="inbox-icon">' + icon + '</div>' +
        '<div>' +
          '<div class="inbox-name">' + safeName + ' · 📱 ' + m.phone + '</div>' +
          '<div class="inbox-msg">' + safeMsg + '</div>' +
          '<div class="inbox-meta">' + (m.receivedAt || '') + '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="inbox-actions">' +
          '<a href="https://wa.me/' + m.phone + '" target="_blank" class="inbox-btn" style="background:#25D366;color:#fff;border-color:#25D366;text-decoration:none;text-align:center">↗ WhatsApp</a>' +
          (m.status === 'unread' ? '<button class="inbox-btn" onclick="markMsgRead(\'' + m.id + '\')">Marcar lida</button>' : '') +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  } catch(e) { body.innerHTML = '<div class="inbox-empty">Erro de conexão</div>'; }
}
async function markMsgRead(msgId){
  try {
    await fetch(BASE + '/agenda-projeto-1-admin-clientes', {
      method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: getToken(), action:'markMessageRead', msgId })
    });
    loadClientMessages();
  } catch(e) {}
}
